reason: 2K Czech is not an independent studio at all — it is the Brno/Prague arm of Hangar 13, a wholly-owned label studio of Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ: TTWO), acquired January 2008 and merged into Hangar 13 in 2017 (Wikipedia; MobyGames; 2k.com/studios/hangar-13), with sites in Brno, Prague and Brighton — so it fails Ben Cole's US-based, funded-independent, 20-150-employee ICP on every axis and is the wrong side of the market (a public publisher's internal studio, not a funded indie), and Take-Two itself was already dropped in this same run; the matched postings are anti-signal too: 'Senior Gameplay & Animation Engineer' is explicitly on his NOT-list ('not a gameplay/engine/creative technology leader'), and the two Senior Network Engineer reqs state 'The 2K Network Operations team is responsible for...' — i.e. the non-creative operations layer Ben sells is already a staffed, centralized corporate function here, not an unowned one burning the Tech Director's time.
